# Trish Nymark

Trish Nymark is identified in the corpus as the Formand (chair) of the ADHD-foreningen (the Danish ADHD Association) and as the pårørenderepræsentant (relative/family representative) on the steering group for the ADHD-database, a Danish health quality database that monitors the assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under 18 [^src1][^src2]. She appears in the annual reports of the database for two consecutive years, in 2023 and 2024, each time listed among the steering group members drawn from Denmark's hospitals, medical specialties, and patient organizations [^src1][^src2].

The ADHD-database itself tracks quality-of-care measures for children and young people diagnosed with or evaluated for ADHD, drawing on data from all five Danish regions and covering periods such as 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024, and later 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025 [^src1][^src2]. Its steering group brings together senior physicians (overlæger), specialist doctors, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists, and — as in Nymark's case — representatives of patients' relatives, alongside bodies such as Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut [^src1][^src2]. As chair of ADHD-foreningen, Nymark represents the patient/family voice within this clinical and administrative structure, a role reflected consistently across both the 2023 and 2024 editions of the report, where her title is rendered as "Formand for ADHD foreningen" and "Formand for ADHD-foreningen" respectively [^src1][^src2].

No further biographical detail, additional claims, or timeline events beyond her steering-group role are present in the available data.
